correctness.rationale: The Paley-31 tournament and every transitive face are reconstructed from first principles. The verifier checks 27,931 nonempty faces, all 126,015 Hasse covers, and acyclicity of a 13,396-pair matching. The resulting Morse CW model has critical counts 1 in dimension 0, 89 in dimension 3, and 1,049 in dimension 4. Its exact 89-by-1,049 boundary has full rank modulo 2,3,5,7,101,601; a recorded maximal minor has determinant -601, while full rank modulo 601 forces the maximal determinantal divisor to be 1. Hence the Smith form is 89 unit factors plus 960 zero columns. Hurewicz then identifies the 4-cell attaching classes with this matrix, and Smith equivalence gives the cofiber wedge of 960 4-spheres.

value.rationale: Paley-31 is a canonical quadratic-residue doubly regular tournament at the first admissible order immediately beyond the owning source’s complete order-27 DRT topology census. Lower DRT orders already show torsion and mixed Moore-space phenomena, so an exact next-order homotopy benchmark is structurally motivated rather than a routine parameter increment. The result gives a reusable exact face/Morse/Smith certificate for this natural test object.
